answer_1.quote: headline generation (HG) is becoming an important task and draw increasing attention nowadays, which aims to automatically generate the appropriate headline for a given article.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE and BLEU as metrics to automatically evaluate the quality of generated headlines of all baseline models and our CLH3G model.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 50 news from the test set and asked three annotators to rerank the five generated headline and the reference headline, while the ranked first get 6 points, and the ranked last get 1 point.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators reranked headlines based on fluency, relevance, and attraction.
